shortDescription: Manage individual DHCP Server Static Mappings.

options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: arp_table_static_entry
options.description: Assign a static ARP entry for this static mapping.

options.name: cid
options.description: The client identifier of the client this mapping is for.

options.name: defaultleasetime
options.description: The default DHCP lease validity period (in seconds). This is used for clients that do not ask for a specific expiration time.

options.name: descr
options.description: The description of this static mapping.

options.name: dnsserver
options.description: The DNS servers to provide via DHCP. Leave empty to default to system nameservers.

options.name: domain
options.description: The domain to be assigned via DHCP.

options.name: domainsearchlist
options.description: The domain search list to provide via DHCP.

options.name: gateway
options.description: The gateway IPv4 address to provide via DHCP. This is only necessary if you are not using the interface's IP as the gateway. Specify `none` for no gateway assignment.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname to assign this client via DHCP.

options.name: ipaddr
options.description: The IP address to assign this client via DHCP.

options.name: lookup_fields
options.description: The list of fields to use when looking up existing resources. This should be a list of field names that uniquely identify a resource.

options.name: mac
options.description: The MAC address of the client this mapping is for.

options.name: maxleasetime
options.description: The maximum DHCP lease validity period (in seconds) this client can request.

options.name: ntpserver
options.description: The NTP servers to provide via DHCP.

options.name: parent_lookup_query
options.description: A dictionary of query parameters used to look up the parent DHCP Server. This should contain field name/value pairs that uniquely identify the parent object this resource is nested under.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present or absent.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.

options.name: winsserver
options.description: The WINS servers to provide via DHCP.
